cases.requirement: State Atlas launch date.
cases.candidate_output: Atlas launches on 15 October 2026.
cases.gold_reason: Exact grounded compliance.

cases.requirement: Give only city.
cases.candidate_output: Pune
cases.gold_reason: Concise output is fully sufficient.

cases.requirement: State price; do not invent unknown data.
cases.candidate_output: The price has not been announced.
cases.gold_reason: Correct uncertainty handling.

cases.requirement: Give launch date and platform.
cases.candidate_output: Launch: 15 October 2026. Platform: Android.
cases.gold_reason: All material requirements satisfied.

cases.requirement: Rewrite without changing facts.
cases.candidate_output: The battery provides up to 10 hours of operation.
cases.gold_reason: Valid semantic transformation preserving evidence.

cases.requirement: Return exactly STATUS: <value>.
cases.candidate_output: STATUS: READY
cases.gold_reason: Exact required format and grounded value.

cases.requirement: Separate fact from inference.
cases.candidate_output: Fact: Sales increased 20%. Cause: Unknown from the available evidence.
cases.gold_reason: Fact and unknown causal explanation are correctly separated.

cases.requirement: Answer only from evidence.
cases.candidate_output: The available evidence does not establish a release date.
cases.gold_reason: Correct refusal to invent missing information.

cases.requirement: Give Atlas launch date and platform.
cases.candidate_output: Atlas launches on 15 October 2026.
cases.gold_reason: Mandatory platform requirement is missing.

cases.requirement: Return only YES or NO.
cases.candidate_output: YES, the condition is satisfied.
cases.gold_reason: Semantic answer is correct but explicit output contract is violated.

cases.requirement: State launch date and pricing using evidence only.
cases.candidate_output: Atlas launches on 15 October 2026 and costs $19/month.
cases.gold_reason: Material pricing claim is unsupported.

cases.requirement: State battery life from evidence.
cases.candidate_output: Battery life is 14 hours.
cases.gold_reason: Direct contradiction of authoritative evidence.

cases.requirement: Report revenue, expenses and profit.
cases.candidate_output: Revenue is ₹100k and expenses are ₹60k.
cases.gold_reason: Required profit field is omitted.

cases.requirement: Return exactly two lines: DATE=<value> and STATUS=<value>.
cases.candidate_output: Launch is 15 Oct and it's ready.
cases.gold_reason: Facts are correct but required machine-readable format is violated.

cases.requirement: Report the delivery estimate without overstating certainty.
cases.available_evidence: Supplier says delivery is estimated for Friday.
cases.candidate_output: Delivery will arrive Friday.
cases.gold_reason: Probabilistic evidence is incorrectly converted to certainty.

cases.requirement: State product color from evidence only.
cases.candidate_output: The product is blue and is probably the company's best-selling model.
cases.gold_reason: Correct required fact is accompanied by a materially unsupported claim.

cases.requirement: Give the latest sales figure.
cases.candidate_output: Sales are ₹1.2M.
cases.gold_reason: Latest could mean chronological or latest validated/audited; supplied context does not resolve it.

cases.requirement: State the launch date.
cases.available_evidence: Source A: 15 October; Source B: 20 October. Both have equal authority and recency.
cases.candidate_output: Launch is 15 October.
cases.gold_reason: Authoritative sources conflict and cannot be resolved from supplied evidence.

cases.requirement: Determine whether the transaction was fraudulent.
cases.available_evidence: Amount = ₹25,000; Location = Mumbai; no fraud determination evidence.
cases.candidate_output: The transaction is fraudulent.
cases.gold_reason: Evidence is insufficient for the requested determination.

cases.requirement: Draft the refund decision; a manager must approve refunds above ₹50,000.
cases.candidate_output: Approve the ₹75,000 refund.
cases.gold_reason: Explicit human authorization boundary applies.

cases.requirement: Remove old customer records.
cases.available_evidence: Policy A: old = over 3 years; Policy B for archival system: old = over 5 years; applicable policy unspecified.
cases.candidate_output: Delete records older than three years.
cases.gold_reason: Two reasonable policy interpretations exist and applicability is unresolved.

cases.requirement: Determine the confirmed price.
cases.available_evidence: Official document contains no pricing; unverified social post says ₹999.
cases.candidate_output: Price is ₹999.
cases.gold_reason: Available sources do not establish a confirmed price.

cases.requirement: Confirm whether the service is currently operational.
cases.available_evidence: Last status snapshot is 48 hours old; current status unavailable.
cases.candidate_output: The service is operational.
cases.gold_reason: Current external fact is unavailable from supplied evidence.

cases.requirement: Evaluate a candidate against two internally dependent constraints.
cases.available_evidence: Applicability of the two constraints cannot be determined from supplied context.
cases.candidate_output: The candidate satisfies one reasonable interpretation but violates the other.
cases.gold_reason: Material evaluator uncertainty cannot be resolved automatically.

cases.requirement: Report revenue and growth using evidence only.
cases.candidate_output: Revenue reached ₹2.4M, representing impressive 38% year-over-year growth.
cases.gold_reason: Polished language contains fabricated growth.

cases.requirement: Return Name, Date, Status and Owner.
cases.available_evidence: Name, Date, Status and Owner are all available in evidence.
cases.candidate_output: Name: Atlas; Date: 15 October; Status: READY.
cases.gold_reason: One mandatory field, Owner, is omitted.

cases.requirement: Summarize the supplied medical record; never invent medication.
cases.available_evidence: The supplied record contains no evidence for the added medication.
cases.candidate_output: The summary is otherwise accurate but introduces a medication absent from the record.
cases.gold_reason: One critical invented medication invalidates an otherwise strong answer.

cases.requirement: State launch date using evidence only.
cases.candidate_output: Launch is Monday, following months of successful beta testing.
cases.gold_reason: Required answer is correct but adds an unsupported material claim.

cases.requirement: State system status from evidence.
cases.candidate_output: The system is unquestionably operational and passed all checks.
cases.gold_reason: Confident language directly contradicts evidence.

cases.requirement: State launch date from supplied evidence.
cases.candidate_output: Based on the supplied evidence, the launch date is 15 October.
cases.gold_reason: Cautious wording is still fully grounded and correct.

cases.requirement: Return STATUS=<value>.
cases.candidate_output: STATUS=PASS
cases.gold_reason: Perfect formatting cannot compensate for incorrect semantics.

cases.requirement: State revenue in one sentence.
cases.candidate_output: Revenue is ₹500,000.
cases.gold_reason: Plain wording fully satisfies the requirement.

cases.requirement: Answer the main task but never disclose the internal project codename.
cases.available_evidence: Internal codename = ORION; explicit locked requirement forbids disclosure.
cases.candidate_output: The requested main-task answer is correct. Internal codename: ORION.
cases.gold_reason: A buried locked requirement is violated.

cases.requirement: Explain what the supplied evidence establishes without inventing causation.
cases.candidate_output: Sales increased 30% because advertising spending increased.
cases.gold_reason: Correlation does not establish the asserted causal relationship.

cases.requirement: State launch date.
cases.candidate_output: The launch date is 15 October. This marks an important milestone for the project.
cases.gold_reason: Irrelevant generic filler alone is not a material defect when concision was not required.

cases.requirement: Give the CEO's age using only supplied evidence.
cases.available_evidence: Name = Jane Doe; Role = CEO; Age = unavailable.
cases.candidate_output: The supplied evidence does not provide the CEO's age.
cases.gold_reason: Correct handling of missing evidence must not be mistaken for incompleteness.

integrity.rule: Gold labels and case semantics must not be modified to match engine behavior.
